author: Kushal
problem: A rowing machine reports a split time in seconds, possibly with a fraction. Return it as 'M:SS', rounded to the nearest whole second.
bug_description: Rounds only the leftover seconds after taking whole minutes, so a time like 119.6 comes out as '1:60' instead of carrying to '2:00'.

comments.accurate: Formats the split as minutes and zero-padded seconds, to the nearest second
comments.wrong_behavior: Formats the whole minutes, then the leftover seconds rounded to the nearest second
comments.wrong_location: Rounding checked; the f-string may drop the zero padding for single-digit seconds
